geneExpressionPyramid.name: label
geneExpressionPyramid.documentation: A human-readable label for this pyramid (e.g. 'Opossum V1 Stereo-seq').

geneExpressionPyramid.name: assay
geneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The spatial transcriptomics assay that produced the data (e.g. 'Stereo-seq', 'Visium', 'Xenium').

geneExpressionPyramid.name: species
geneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The species of the tissue, preferably as an ontology node (e.g. 'NCBITaxon:9265').

geneExpressionPyramid.name: chip_serial
geneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The capture chip serial number, if the assay uses one. For Stereo-seq this is the SAW 'sn' field.

geneExpressionPyramid.name: pipeline_version
geneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The version of the primary analysis pipeline that produced the counts (e.g. 'SAW v7.1.2').

geneExpressionPyramid.name: annotation_source
geneExpressionPyramid.documentation: Identifier of the genome annotation (GTF) used to assign reads to genes. Counts are not reproducible without it.

geneExpressionPyramid.name: n_genes
geneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The number of genes in genes.tsv. Every gene_index stored in a tile must be less than this value.

geneExpressionPyramid.name: bin_sizes
geneExpressionPyramid.documentation: Vector of the bin sizes present in this pyramid, in base pixel units, finest first (e.g. [1 5 10 20 50]). One geneExpressionTiles document exists per entry.

geneExpressionPyramid.name: base_pixel_size_x
geneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The physical size of one base (bin size 1) pixel in x, in pixel_size_units. For Stereo-seq at 500 nm DNB pitch this is 0.5.

geneExpressionPyramid.name: base_pixel_size_y
geneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The physical size of one base (bin size 1) pixel in y, in pixel_size_units.

geneExpressionPyramid.name: pixel_size_units
geneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The units of base_pixel_size_x, base_pixel_size_y, origin_x, origin_y, extent_x, and extent_y.

geneExpressionPyramid.name: origin_x
geneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The x coordinate of the upper-left corner of tile (0,0), in the source coordinate system. For Stereo-seq this is the GEF minX. Required to register tiles against cell centroids, segmentation contours, and stain images.

geneExpressionPyramid.name: origin_y
geneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The y coordinate of the upper-left corner of tile (0,0), in the source coordinate system (GEF minY for Stereo-seq).

geneExpressionPyramid.name: extent_x
geneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The full width of the tiled region, in base pixel units. Equal to tile_columns * tile_size_x_bins * bin_size at every level.

geneExpressionPyramid.name: extent_y
geneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The full height of the tiled region, in base pixel units.

geneExpressionPyramid.name: tile_rows
geneExpressionPyramid.documentation: Number of tile rows. Identical at every level, so a tile (row,column) covers the same physical region at every bin size and a viewport maps to tile indices once.

geneExpressionPyramid.name: tile_columns
geneExpressionPyramid.documentation: Number of tile columns. Identical at every level.

geneExpressionPyramid.name: index_order
geneExpressionPyramid.documentation: How a (row,column) tile pair maps to the numeric suffix N in tile.bin_N. 'row-major' means N = row*tile_columns + column; 'column-major' means N = column*tile_rows + row.

geneExpressionPyramid.name: origin_corner
geneExpressionPyramid.documentation: Which corner of the tiled region tile (0,0) occupies: 'upper-left' or 'lower-left'. Determines whether row index increases with increasing y.

geneExpressionPyramid.name: byte_order
geneExpressionPyramid.documentation: Byte order of all multi-byte values in the tile files: 'little' or 'big'.
